astronaut.png

Public-domain NASA photograph, obtained from scikit-image v0.19.3:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.19.3/skimage/data/astronaut.png

Source and public-domain statement:
https://scikit-image.org/docs/0.19.x/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut

Used only as a real face-detection and foreground-segmentation regression
fixture. It is not loaded by the app. All other test images are generated
temporarily by the test suite.
